# HN Top 10
> Daily Korean translation and summary of Hacker News top 10 stories.

## About
HN Top 10 automatically translates and summarizes the top Hacker News stories into Korean every day for developers who want a concise view of global technology news.

## Features
- Daily top Hacker News stories
- Korean translation and summary
- Original article links preserved
- Date navigation for previous editions

## Language
- Korean, translated from English sources

## Category
Technology news, developer news, Hacker News curation
